summary: Compute exact degree-block quotient coordinates and transition matrices between the two ten-element families for J=[333,5^5], using complete h_1,...,h_5 Pieri relation lattices. For each degree 9,...,15, certify a unimodular quotient complement, report the ordered G_L/G_R blocks, transition matrix [G_L]=T_d[G_R], determinant, and Smith diagonal; also report global block determinant/Smith data.

from itertools import combinations
from fractions import Fraction

lower=(3,3,3,0,0)
upper=(5,5,5,5,5)

def trim(p):
    p=tuple(x for x in p)
    while p and p[-1]==0: p=p[:-1]
    return p

def wt(p): return sum(p)
def key(p): return tuple([-x for x in p]+[0]*(5-len(p)))
def inside(p):
    q=p+(0,)*(5-len(p))
    return all(lower[i]<=q[i]<=upper[i] for i in range(5))
def parts(n,maxv=5,maxlen=5):
    out=[]
    def rec(rem,last,a):
        if rem==0:
            out.append(trim(tuple(a))); return
        if len(a)==maxlen: return
        for x in range(min(last,rem),0,-1): rec(rem-x,x,a+[x])
    rec(n,maxv,[]); return out

def horizontal(mu,k):
    # nu/mu horizontal k iff interlacing nu1>=mu1>=nu2>=mu2...
    mu=mu+(0,)*(5-len(mu))
    ans=[]
    for nu in parts(sum(mu)+k):
        q=nu+(0,)*(5-len(nu))
        if all(q[i]>=mu[i] and (i==4 or mu[i]>=q[i+1]) for i in range(5)):
            ans.append(trim(q))
    return ans

def det(A):
    n=len(A)
    if n==0:return 1
    B=[list(map(int,r)) for r in A]; sign=1; prev=1
    for k in range(n-1):
        piv=next((i for i in range(k,n) if B[i][k]),None)
        if piv is None:return 0
        if piv!=k:B[k],B[piv]=B[piv],B[k];sign=-sign
        pivot=B[k][k]
        for i in range(k+1,n):
            for j in range(k+1,n): B[i][j]=(B[i][j]*pivot-B[i][k]*B[k][j])//prev
        prev=pivot
        for i in range(k+1,n): B[i][k]=0
    return sign*B[-1][-1]

def invsolve(A,b):
    n=len(A); M=[[Fraction(x) for x in A[i]]+[Fraction(b[i])] for i in range(n)]
    for k in range(n):
        p=next(i for i in range(k,n) if M[i][k])
        M[k],M[p]=M[p],M[k]
        z=M[k][k]; M[k]=[x/z for x in M[k]]
        for i in range(n):
            if i!=k and M[i][k]:
                z=M[i][k];M[i]=[M[i][j]-z*M[k][j] for j in range(n+1)]
    return [M[i][-1] for i in range(n)]

def smith_diag(A):
    # determinantal-divisor calculation: enumerate minors only for the small quotient transition blocks
    n=len(A)
    ds=[]; old=1
    for k in range(1,n+1):
        g=0
        for I in combinations(range(n),k):
            for J in combinations(range(n),k):
                g=__import__('math').gcd(g,abs(det([[A[i][j] for j in J] for i in I])))
        ds.append(g//old);old=g
    return ds

GL=sorted([trim((3,3,3)+rho) for rho in [(a,b) for a in range(3,-1,-1) for b in range(a,-1,-1)]],key=key)
GR=sorted([trim((5,)*k+(3,)*(3-k)) for k in range(4)],key=key) # wrong interim, replace by all between 333 and 555
GR=sorted([p for n in range(9,16) for p in parts(n) if all((p+(0,)*(5-len(p)))[i]>=3 for i in range(3)) and all((p+(0,)*(5-len(p)))[i]==0 for i in range(3,5))],key=key)
# Explicitly, G_L has top three 3 and appended partition rho; G_R has a partition rho added to first three rows.
GL=sorted([trim((3,3,3)+rho) for rho in [(a,b) for a in range(3,-1,-1) for b in range(a,-1,-1)]],key=key)
GR=sorted([trim(tuple(3+x for x in rho)+(3,)*(3-len(rho))) for rho in [(a,b,c) for a in range(3,-1,-1) for b in range(a,-1,-1) for c in range(b,-1,-1)]],key=key)
print('GL_ALL', [''.join(map(str,p)) for p in GL])
print('GR_ALL', [''.join(map(str,p)) for p in GR])
assert len(GL)==len(GR)==10
allT=[]
for d in range(9,16):
    C=sorted([p for p in parts(d) if inside(p)],key=key); idx={p:i for i,p in enumerate(C)}; n=len(C)
    rows=[]; labels=[]
    for t in range(1,6):
        for mu in parts(d-t):
            if inside(mu):
                r=[0]*n
                for nu in horizontal(mu,t):
                    if nu in idx:r[idx[nu]]+=1
                if any(r):rows.append(r);labels.append('h%d*%s'%(t,''.join(map(str,mu))))
    L=[p for p in GL if wt(p)==d]; R=[p for p in GR if wt(p)==d]
    li=[idx[p] for p in L];ri=[idx[p] for p in R]; q=len(L)
    # Search a unimodular complement among relation rows, greedily exhaustive combinations.
    def findcomp(base):
        need=n-q
        for I in combinations(range(len(rows)),need):
            A=[rows[i] for i in I]+[[1 if j==c else 0 for j in range(n)] for c in base]
            z=det(A)
            if abs(z)==1:return I,A,z
        raise RuntimeError('no complement')
    IL,AL,dl=findcomp(li);IR,AR,dr=findcomp(ri)
    # Each L basis vector represented in R quotient coordinates: solve AR^T x=eL; final q entries x are coordinates.
    T=[]
    for c in li:
        x=invsolve([[AR[j][i] for j in range(n)] for i in range(n)],[1 if i==c else 0 for i in range(n)])
        v=x[n-q:]
        assert all(y.denominator==1 for y in v)
        T.append([int(y) for y in v])
    # Verify differences by solving relation sublattice based on R complement and T.
    for rr,c in enumerate(li):
        vec=[0]*n;vec[c]=1
        for cc,rc in enumerate(ri):vec[rc]-=T[rr][cc]
        x=invsolve([[AR[j][i] for j in range(n)] for i in range(n)],vec)
        assert all(y.denominator==1 for y in x) and all(x[j]==0 for j in range(n-q,n))
    td=det(T); sd=smith_diag(T)
    print('DEGREE',d,'COLUMNS',[''.join(map(str,p)) for p in C])
    print('GL',[''.join(map(str,p)) for p in L],'GR',[''.join(map(str,p)) for p in R])
    print('REL_SHAPE',len(rows),n,'L_COMP',[labels[i] for i in IL],'R_COMP',[labels[i] for i in IR],'detL',dl,'detR',dr)
    print('T',T,'det',td,'SNF',sd)
    allT += [row[:] for row in T]
print('GLOBAL_DET',det(allT),'GLOBAL_SNF',smith_diag(allT))
